stories.title: 3 Italian ‘Hobbits’ Searched for Irishman’s ‘Precious’ Wedding Ring for Days Before Bringing it to His Home
stories.label: people
stories.summary: An Irish tourist lost his wedding ring in a mountain stream while on vacation in Italy, and thought it was gone for good. Three young local men, inspired by the loyalty and determination of Tolkien's hobbits, spent days searching the stream until they found it. Rather than keep it or sell it, they tracked down the man's address and delivered the ring to his home themselves. It's a small, sweet reminder that strangers still go out of their way to do the right thing for no reward at all. The Irishman got his precious back, and three new friends in Italy besides.
stories.why_good: A real act of kindness that actually happened, with no political angle and no suffering at its core - just strangers choosing generosity.
